title: Invoice Profile - Germany (effective 2025-01-01)
description: Germany invoice profile based on UStG section 14 requirements. Aligned with the e-invoicing mandate that introduces obligation for B2B e-invoices (XRechnung / ZUGFeRD) from 2025-01-01.

vat_id.notes: Required for intra-EU transactions and when seller is VAT-registered.

tax_number.notes: Either Steuernummer or USt-IdNr. must be present (UStG section 14(4) no. 2).

mandate.notes: From 2025-01-01 all German B2B recipients must be able to receive structured e-invoices. Issuing obligation is phased through 2027-2028.

notes: Small-amount invoices (Kleinbetragsrechnungen, gross <= 250 EUR) have reduced field requirements per UStDV section 33.
Reverse-charge invoices must include a note 'Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers'.
